description: This file defines an interface for AES stream operations within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifying methods related to AES encryption names and IV management.

classes.name: AesStreamInterfaceV2
classes.description: An interface extending StreamInterface, providing methods for retrieving AES encryption details such as AES name, OpenSSL name, and IV.

methods.name: getStaticAesName
methods.description: Returns an AES recognizable name, such as 'AES/GCM/NoPadding'. accessible as a static method.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns an identifier compatible with openssl functions, such as 'aes-256-cbc'.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the current initialization vector (IV) used for encryption or decryption.
